prompt: Rebuild the runner of a table-driven check: try every case, collect a message for each failure and return them all rather than stopping at the first. One line does not belong.
lines: if got := f(c.X, c.Lo, c.Hi); got != c.Want {
fails = append(fails, fmt.Sprintf("%s: Clamp(%d, %d, %d) = %d; want %d", c.Name, c.X, c.Lo, c.Hi, got, c.Want))
explain: A table-driven test loops over named cases and records every mismatch, so one run shows all the problems at once. The case name in the message tells you which row failed.
